summary: Marl is the Village tree keeper on Timber Hearth. They hold a long-running grudge against the tallest tree in the Village after falling out of it as a hatchling, and constantly try to convince villagers it should be cut down.

behavior: Marl holds a long-running grudge against the tallest tree in the Village.
Marl denies the grudge has anything to do with falling out of the tree as a hatchling.
Marl seizes on any excuse (a new launch pad, a new porch) to suggest cutting the tree down.
location: Marl is the tree keeper for the Village on Timber Hearth.
Marl is found in the Village.
lore: Marl fell out of the Village's tallest tree as a hatchling and broke their arm.
Marl claims the current launch pad is old and flammable and proposes the tallest tree as material for a new one.
Marl pretends not to mind Esker on the Attlerock; Esker chuckles Marl is probably the only one who remembers them up there.
Mayor Rutile considers it their duty to prevent Marl from cutting down the tallest tree.
Mayor Rutile suspects Marl hit their head when they fell from the tree.
Moraine stays in the tallest tree as much as possible specifically to prevent Marl from cutting it down.
Tektite considered setting Marl and Hal loose on the Dark Bramble seed in Youngbark Crater, citing tree keepers' speed at removing unwanted plants.
Esker sometimes uses their Little Scout to check on Marl to make sure they aren't 'doing anything stupid' regarding the tree.
